title: Inviting friends
summary: Get your friends into your Realm of Thrones server.

sections.heading: Send your mod list
steps: On the Mods page, open More and click Share mod list.
Send the file to your players. They click Import mod list in the client launcher before they join.
sections.tip: Every player needs the same mods as the server, so send the file again after you change the setup.

sections.heading: Join with your address
steps: Give players your IP address and UDP port 4200. That is the recommended way.
Forward UDP port 4200 on your router.
Open the port on my router automatically and Allow through firewall on the Dashboard help when friends cannot reach you.
Do not give friends any port other than 4200.

sections.heading: Steam lobby
steps: Leave Advertise through Steam off unless friends join through Steam with your Steam name. Everyone else joins on UDP port 4200.
To use it, tick Advertise through Steam on the Settings page before you click Start server.
Keep Steam running and give friends your Steam profile name.

sections.heading: Password
steps: Type a password under Join on the Settings page if you want one.
Give players that same password. An empty password is fine.

sections.heading: The first join
steps: A player's first join takes several minutes while their game compiles shaders and prepares the map.
The server waits longer than normal for a joining player, so do not kick them.
